title: The Speakeasy Mint: ALT style sweep
heading: Speakeasy Mint: a second style
moodboard_intro: Jack, 2026-10-28. Round 3 (top): the whole ALT film, 33 scenes on Kai's lyrics, with more gangster and prohibition imagery, a psychedelic layer on each scene over a realistic, lit world, and a match-cut transition out of each (see script-alt.md). Rounds 2 and 1 below. Vote This / Maybe / No per scene and leave notes.

beats.name: Round 3 · The turn (31–33)

beats.name: Round 2: psychedelic overlays on a real world
beats.blurb: Jack 2026-10-28: realistic underneath, a different psychedelic layer on top; each style on a different scene. Kept apart from Tarquin's trip (no acid green, violet or lattice patterns).

beats.name: Round 2: the transition test (furnace fire → protest fire)
beats.blurb: The two ends of one match cut: push into the furnace flame, come out of the protest drum's flame. Same tall flame, dead centre.

beats.name: Scene 5: the slot door
beats.blurb: The gangster murmurs the password into the slot.

beats.name: Scene 13: the press
beats.blurb: The mayor shovels coal into the red-hot press.
